verdict.rationale: Vercel Blob is Vercel's own first-party object storage service. Its docs describe it as storage for "files your app uploads or serves", with dedicated Server Uploads and Client Uploads pages, client tokens for browser uploads, multipart uploads, JS/Python SDKs, and a choice of store region. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration that Blob uploads work in practice, and the upload flows are evidenced only through nav and body references rather than detailed page content.

support.subject: As a developer, I can persist user-generated uploads using built-in object storage

citations.quote: Vercel Blob is Vercel's object storage for files. Use it to store images, videos, documents, and other files your app uploads or serves.
Vercel Blob is a scalable, cost-effective object storage service with private and public access modes for files up to 5 TB.
Each store lives in one region that you choose, and Vercel's CDN caches your files close to your users.
